description.content:
Returns a single listing, including its ancestors, siblings and children. Listings can be queried by either their Depict ID, or "external" ID, which is the ID used by the merchant's system (ie Shopify, Centra, WooCommerce, etc) to refer to the listing. Useful for showing breadcrumbs and other navigation elements while showing a product listing page. Example response: 
{
    "listing_id": "06b234cf-ce21-4252-90e6-db47246b1d98",
    "external_id": "1011",
    "listing_type": "category",
    "show_in_breadcrumbs": true,
    "show_in_quicklinks": true,

description.content: REST API behind Depict Lite, the native Shopify app: onboarding, collections, boost & bury, dashboards, A/B testing and multi-store management. Endpoints are served under the /api/lite prefix and require an Auth0-issued bearer token.
